name: SEOTesting
description:
SEOTesting connects Claude to your Google Search Console data so you can analyse organic performance, find opportunities, and prove the impact of SEO changes — using your own first-party clicks and impressions, not third-party estimates.

Ask Claude to:

• Analyse site, page, and query performance over any date range
• Find striking-distance queries, CTR opportunities, decaying content, and weekly winners and losers
• Create SEO tests when you change a page, so before-and-after impact is measured automatically
• Track keyword rankings and add annotations to mark changes on your performance graphs
• Run content analysis: query fan-out, content coverage evaluation, and page quality checks

Built for in-house SEO teams, agencies, and consultants who need to show what SEO work made a difference — for a manager, a client, or themselves.

Requires a SEOTesting account (14-day free trial) with a website connected to Google Search Console. Connect from Claude and sign in — no API keys to manage. The connector can read your performance data and create tests, annotations, tracked keywords, and content-group entries; it never deletes anything.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SEOTesting to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SEOTesting to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.seotesting.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SEOTesting MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEOTesting lists 39 MCP tools, including add_urls_to_content_group, analyze_list_table_suggestions, analyze_unanchored_claims, analyze_unclear_headings, analyze_vague_language, create_annotation, create_group_test, create_test, create_tracked_keyword, evaluate_content, generate_query_fanout, and get_annotation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SEOTesting?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SEOTesting in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
SEOTesting requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SEOTesting is developed by SEOTesting. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
